G3000.def:
λατρεύω
(λάτρις, a hired servant), [in LXX (always, as λατρεία, of the service of God or of heathen divinities) chiefly for עָבַד, Êx 3:12, al.; in Dan LXX TH (Dn 3:12, al.) for פְּלַח ;]
__1. to work for hire.
__2. to serve; in cl., also of divine service, to serve, worship, and so always in NT: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, Mt 4:10, Lc 4:8" (LXX), At 7:7 24:14 27:23, Hb 9:14, Ap 7:15 22:3; of idol worship (cf. Êx 20:5, Eze.20:32), At 7:42, Rm 1:25; τ. θεῷ. ἐν τ. πνεύματί μου, Rm 1:9; id. ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, 2Tm 1:3; μετ᾽ εὐλαβείας κ. δέους, Hb 12:28; ἐν ὁσιότητι κ. δικαιοσύνῃ, Lc 1:74; (without θεῷ) νηστείαις κ. δεήσεσι, Lc 2:37; πνεύματι θεοῦ, Fp 3:3; absol., At 26:7; ὁ λατρεύων, the worshipper, Hb 9:9 10:2; of ministerial service, with dative of thing(s), Hb 8:5 13:10.†
SYN.: λειτουργέω, q.v (AS)

G3001.def:
λάχανον, -ου, τό
(λαχαίνω, to dig), [in LXX: Gn 9:3; 3Ki.21:2, Sl 37:2, Pv 15:17 (יֶרֶק, יָרָק) * ;]
a garden herb, vegetable: Lc 11:42; usually in pl., Mt 13:32, Mc 4:32, Rm 14:2.†
SYN.: βοτάνη, q.v (AS)

G3002.def:
λεββαῖος, -ου, ὁ
(on the derivation, see Dalman, Words, 50; Swete, Mk., l.with),
Lebbæus: Mt 10:3, Mc 3:18 (WH, mg.; Θαδδαῖος, which see, Rec., WH, txt., RV, cf. WH, App., 11, 24. In Lc 6:15, At 1:13, he is called Σίμων ὁ Ζηλωτής.)†
(AS)

G3003.def:
λεγιών (Rec. -εών), -ῶνος, ἡ, (Lat. legio),
a legion: Mt 26:53, Mc 5:9, 15, Lc 8:30.†
(AS)

G3004G.def:
λέγω,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, Gn 22:16, al. ;]
__1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
__2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., At 13:15, 24:10; before orat. dir., Mt 9:34, Mc 3:11, Jo 1:29, al.; before ὅτι recit., Mc 3:21, Lc 1:24, Jo 6:14, al.; accusative and inf., Lc 11:18, Jo 12:29, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, Mt 11:17, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), Mt 25:9, Mc 3:33, 7:28, Lc 24:6, 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Mt 3:9, Lc 3:8, al.; of writing, 2Co 8:8, Fp 4:11, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, Rm 4:3, Tg 2:23, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Lc 8:8, 9:33, Jo 5:34, al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), Mt 27:11, Mc 15:2, Lc 23:3, Jo 18:37; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., Mt 8:20, Mc 2:17, al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, Mt 3:9, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., Mc 4:41, Jo 11:56, Hb 9:5, al.; to mean (cl.), Mc 14:71, Jo 6:71, 1Co 10:29, al.; to call, name, Mc 10:18; pass., Mt 9:9, Mc 15:7, al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G3004H.def:
λέγω,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, Gn 22:16, al. ;]
__1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
__2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., At 13:15, 24:10; before orat. dir., Mt 9:34, Mc 3:11, Jo 1:29, al.; before ὅτι recit., Mc 3:21, Lc 1:24, Jo 6:14, al.; accusative and inf., Lc 11:18, Jo 12:29, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, Mt 11:17, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), Mt 25:9, Mc 3:33, 7:28, Lc 24:6, 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Mt 3:9, Lc 3:8, al.; of writing, 2Co 8:8, Fp 4:11, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, Rm 4:3, Tg 2:23, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Lc 8:8, 9:33, Jo 5:34, al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), Mt 27:11, Mc 15:2, Lc 23:3, Jo 18:37; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., Mt 8:20, Mc 2:17, al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, Mt 3:9, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., Mc 4:41, Jo 11:56, Hb 9:5, al.; to mean (cl.), Mc 14:71, Jo 6:71, 1Co 10:29, al.; to call, name, Mc 10:18; pass., Mt 9:9, Mc 15:7, al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G3005.def:
λεῖμμα (WH, λίμμα, see their App., 154), -τος, τό
(λείπω), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:4 A (שְׁאֵרִית)* ;]
a remnant: Rm 11:5.†
(AS)

G3006.def:
λεῖος, -εία, -εῖον
[in LXX: Gn 27:11, 1Rs 17:40 R (חָלַק, חַלֻּק); ὁδὸς λ., Is 40:4 Α (בִּקְעָה); Pv 2:20 12:13 26:23 * ;]
smooth: opposite to τραχύς, Lc 3:5 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3007.def:
λείπω
[in LXX: Jó 4:11, Pv 19:4 (פָּרַד), al. ;]
__1. trans., to leave, leave behind; pass., to be left behind, to lack before prep. (as more usual in cl.), ἐν, Tg 1:4; with genitive of thing(s), Tg 1:5 2:15.
__2. Intrans., to be gone, to be wanting: with dative of person(s), Lc 18:22, Tt 3:13; τὰ λείποντα, Tt 1:5
(cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, ἐν-κατα-, περι-, ὑπο-λείπω).†
(AS)

G3008.def:
λειτουργέω, -ῶ
(λειτουργός), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת pi., also for עָבַד, צָבָא, etc. ;]
__1. in cl., at Athens, to supply public offices at one's own cost, render public service to the State, hence, generally,
__2. to serve the State, do a service, serve (of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites (Êx 29:30, Nm 16:9, Sir.4:14, 1Ma.10:42, al.; cf. Deiss., BS, 140 f.), Hb 10:11; of Christians: with dative of person(s) before ἐν, Rm 15:27 (cf. Sir.10:25); τ. κυρίῳ, At 13:2.†
SYN.: λατρεύω (which see), prop., to serve for hire, LXX (as some­times in cl.), always of service to the deity on the part of both priests and people (Êx 4:3, Dt 10:12, and similarly in NT). λειτουργέω "is the fulfilment of an office: it has a definite representative character, and corresponds with a function to be discharged". It is therefore used of serving in an office or ministry: in LXX always of priests and Levites, in NT, with its cognates (Rm 13:6 15:27, are not really exceptions), of services rendered either to God or man by apostles, prophets, teachers, and other officers of the church (cf. Tr., Syn., § xxxv; ICC on Rm 1:9; Westc., He., 232 ff.) (AS)

G3009.def:
λειτουργία, -ας, ἡ
(λειτουργέω), [in LXX chiefly for עֲבֹדָה, Nm 4:24, 1Cr 9:13, al. ;]
__1. in cl. (chiefly of Athens), the discharge of a public office at one's own expense (see LS, see word), hence,
__2. a service, ministry; in π. (Deiss., BS, 140 f.) and in LXX (though here also of secular service, 3Ki.1:4, al.), of religious service or ministration; and so in NT: of priestly ministrations, Lc 1:23, Hb 8:6 9:21; figuratively, θυσία καὶ λ. τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, Fp 2:17; of Christian beneficence, 2Co 9:12, Fp 2:30.†
(AS)

G3010.def:
λειτουργικός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for עֲבֹדָה, שָׁרַת; ἔργα, Num_7:5; στολαί Êx 31:10 39:32; σκευή, Nm 4:12, 26, 2Cr 24:14 * ;]
of or for service, ministering: πνεύματα, Hb 1:14.†
(AS)

G3011.def:
λειτουργός, -οῦ, ὁ
(λιός, ἔργον), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת, Js 1:1 A, 3Ki.10:5, Sl 103:21, Sir.7:30, al. ;]
__1. in cl., one who discharges a public office at his own expense, then, generally,
__2. a public servant, a minister, servant: τ. ἁγίων λ., Hb 8:2 (cf. Ne 10:39, Sir, l.with); Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, Rm 15:16; pl., τ. θεοῦ, Rm 13:6, Hb 1:7" (LXX) ; λ. ὑμῶν τ. χρείας μου, Fp 2:25.†
SYN.: see: διάκονος, λειτουργέω (AS)

G3012.def:
λέντιον, -ου, τό (Lat. linteum),
a linen cloth, towel: Jo 13:4-5.†
(AS)

G3013.def:
λεπίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(λέπω, to peel) [in LXX chiefly for קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת ;]
a scale: At 9:18†
(AS)

G3014.def:
λέπρα, -ας, ἡ
(λεπρός), [in LXX for צָרַעַת ;]
leprosy: Mt 8:3, Mc 1:42, Lc 5:12-13†
(AS)

G3015.def:
λεπρός, -ά, -όν
(λεπίς), [in LXX for צָרַע ;]
__1. (in cl.) scaly, rough.
__2. leprous; chiefly as subst., ὁ λ., a leper: Mt 8:2 10:8 11:5, Mc 1:40, Lc 4:27 7:22 17:12; of Simon, formerly a leper, Mt 26:6, Mc 14:3.†
(AS)

G3016.def:
λεπτός, -ή, -όν
(λέπω, to peel),
__1. peeled.
__2. fine, thin, small, light; hence, in late Gk., as subst. τὸ λ., a small coin (one-eighth of an as, AV, mite): Mc 12:42, Lc 12:59 21:2.†
(AS)

G3017G.def:
Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878)
Levi;
__1. the son of Jacob: Hb 7:5, 9, Ap 7:7.
__2. Son of Melchi: Lc 3:24.
__3. Son of Simeon: Lc 3:29.
__4. Son of Alphæus (cf. Μαθθαῖος): Mc 2:14 (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον), Lc 5:27, 29.†
(AS)

G3017H.def:
Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878)
Levi;
__1. the son of Jacob: Hb 7:5, 9, Ap 7:7.
__2. Son of Melchi: Lc 3:24.
__3. Son of Simeon: Lc 3:29.
__4. Son of Alphæus (cf. Μαθθαῖος): Mc 2:14 (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον), Lc 5:27, 29.†
(AS)

G3017I.def:
Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878)
Levi;
__1. the son of Jacob: Hb 7:5, 9, Ap 7:7.
__2. Son of Melchi: Lc 3:24.
__3. Son of Simeon: Lc 3:29.
__4. Son of Alphæus (cf. Μαθθαῖος): Mc 2:14 (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον), Lc 5:27, 29.†
(AS)

G3017J.def:
Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878)
Levi;
__1. the son of Jacob: Hb 7:5, 9, Ap 7:7.
__2. Son of Melchi: Lc 3:24.
__3. Son of Simeon: Lc 3:29.
__4. Son of Alphæus (cf. Μαθθαῖος): Mc 2:14 (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον), Lc 5:27, 29.†
(AS)

G3019.def:
Λευείτης
(Rec. Λευΐτης), -ου, ὁ [in LXX for לֵוִיִּי ;]
a Levite: Lc 10:32, Jo 1:19, At 4:36.†
(AS)

G3021.def:
λευκαίνω
(λευκός), [in LXX: Sl 51:7, Is 1:18 (לָבַן hi.), etc. ;]
to whiten, make white: with accusative of thing(s), Mc 9:3, Ap 7:14.†
(AS)

G3022.def:
λευκο-βύσσινος, -ον
(cf. λευκολινής, a robe of white flax, C.I., 155, 17),
white linen: Ap 19:14 (WH, mg.).†
λευκός, ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for לָבָן ;]
__1. bright, brilliant: of clothing, Mt 17:2, Mc 9:3 16:5, Lc 9:29, At 1:10, Ap 3:5 4:4 6:11 7:9, 13 19:14 (cf. Ec 9:8); ὡς χιών, Mt 28:3; ἐν λ.. (sc. ἱματίοις), Jo 20:12, Ap 3:4; θρόνος, Ap 20:11.
__2. white: Mt 5:36, Ap 1:14 2:17 4:4 6:2 14:14 19:11; figuratively, of garments, Ap 3:18; of ripened grain, Jo 4:35.†
(AS)

G3023.def:
λέων, -οντος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אֲרִי, אַרְיֵה, also for כְּפִיר, etc. ;]
a lion: Hb 11:33, 1Pe 5:8, Ap 4:7 9:8, 17 10:3 13:2; metaphorically, 2Tm 4:17, Ap 5:5.†
(AS)

G3024.def:
λήθη, -ης, ἡ
(λήθω = λανθάνω) [in LXX: Lv 5:15 (מַעַל), Wis.16:11, Sir.14:7, al. ;]
forgetfulness: λ. λαβεῖν (on the phrase, see Mayor, in l): 2Pe 1:9.†
(AS)

G3025.def:
ληνός, -οῦ, ἡ
(in some MSS., LXX and NT, ὁ), [in LXX chiefly for יֶקֶב Nm 18:27, al.; also for רַהַט (Gn 30:38, 41), גַּת (Ne 13:15, al.), etc. ;]
a trough or vat; esp. for the treading of grapes: Mt 21:33, Ap 14:20 19:16; τὴν λ. . . . τὸν μέγαν (a solecism perhaps inadvertent), Ap 14:19 (cf. ὑπολήνιον).†
(AS)

G3027.def:
λῃστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(Ep. ληίς = λεία, booty), [in LXX for גְּדוּד, etc. ;]
a robber, brigand: Mt 21:13 (LXX) Mt 26:55 27:38, 44, Mc 11:17 14:48 15:27, Lc 10:30, 36 19:46 22:52, Jo 10:1, 8 18:40, 2Co 11:26.†
SYN.: κλέπτης, q.v (AS)

G3028.def:
λῆμψις (Rec. λῆψις, so in cl.), -εως, ἡ
(λαμβάνω), [in LXX (λῆψ-): Pv 15:29; λ. δώρων, Pv 15:27 (מַתָּנָה); λ. καὶ δόσις, Sir.41:19 42:7 * ;]
receiving: δόσις καὶ λ., Fp 4:15.†
(AS)

G3029.def:
λίαν,
adv. [in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד Gn 1:31 4:5, Jr 24:3, al.; Tob.9:4, 2Ma.11:1, al. ;]
very, exceedingly: Mt 2:16 4:8 8:28 27:14 Mc 1:35 6:51 (Rec. λ. ἐκ περισσοῦ) Mc 9:3 16:2, Lc 23:8, 2Tm 4:15, II Jn 4, 3Jn.3 (cf. ὑτερλίαν).†
(AS)

G3030.def:
λίβανος, -ου, ὁ
(rarely ἡ), (from the Semitic; cf. the Heb. equiv.), [in LXX for לְבוֹנָה Êx 30:34, Is 60:6; Sir.24:15, al. ;]
__1. in cl., the frankincense-tree.
__2. (Occas. in cl.) frankincense (so Lv 2:1; cf. λιβανωτός): Mt 2:11, Ap 18:13.†
(AS)

G3031.def:
λιβανωτός, -οῦ, ὁ
(λίβανος), [in LXX: 1Cr 9:29, 3Ma.5:2 * ;]
__1. in cl. (and LXX), frankincense, the gum of the libanus.
__2. = Late Gk., λιβανωτρίς, a censer: Ap 8:3, 5 (the same form appears in Inscr.; MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3032.def:
Λιβερῖτνος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. libertinus),
a freedman: ἡ συναγωγὴ ἡ λεγομένη Λιβερτίνων At 6:9 (Bl. thinks the original reading was Λιβυστίνων, Phil. Gosp., 69 f.).†
(AS)

G3033.def: Libya, the north part of Africa west of Egypt, (Odyssey by Homer); in later writers also for the whole Continent (ML)

G3034.def:
λιθάζω
(λίθος), [in LXX (before ἐν λίθοις): 2Rs 16:6 16:13 (סָקַל pi.)* ;]
__1. to throw stones (Arist., Polyb., al.).
__2. = λιθοβολέω (LXX, NT), to pelt with stones, to stone: with accusative of person(s), Jo 8:6 10:31-31 11:8, At 14:10; pass., At 5:26, 2Co 11:25, Hb 11:37 (see DB, Art., " Crimes and punish­ments," and cf. κατα-λιθάζω).†
(AS)

G3035.def:
λίθινος, -η, -ον
(λίθος) [in LXX for אֶבֶן ;]
of stone: Jo 2:6, 2Co 3:3, Ap 9:20.†
(AS)

G3036.def:
λιθο-βολέω, -ῶ
(λίθος, βάλλω), [in LXX for סָקַל, רָגַם, Êx 19:13, Lv 20:2, al. ;]
to pelt with stones, to kill by stoning, to stone (cf. λιθάζω): with accusative of person(s), Mt 21:35 23:37, Lc 13:34 At 7:58-59 14:5; pass., Hb 12:20 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3037.def:
λίθος, -ου, ὁ
(and, in Att.., of precious stones, ἡ.) [in LXX for אֶבֶן, Gn 11:3, al.; λ. τίμιος, for פָּז, Sl 19:10 21:3, Pv 8:19, al. ;]
a stone: Mt 4:6, al.; pl., Mt 3:9, al.; at the entrance of a tomb, Mt 27:60, 66 28:2, Mc 15:46 16:3-4, Lc 24:2, Jo 11:38, 32 11:41 20:1; λ. μυλικός, Lc 17:2, cf. Ap 18:21; of building stones, Mt 21:42, [44], Mt 24:2, Mc 12:10 13:1-2, Lc 19:44 20:17-18 21:5-6 At 4:11, 1Pe 2:7; metaphorically, of Christ, λ. ἀκρογωναῖος, ἐκλεκτός, ἔντιμος, 1Pe 2:6 (LXX); λ. ζῶν, 1Pe 2:4; προσκόμματος, 1Pe 2:8, Rm 9:33; of Christians, λ. ζῶντες, 1Pe 2:5; of precious stones, λ. τίμιος, Ap 17:4 18:12, 16 21:11, 19; ἴασπις, Ap 4:3; ἐνδεδυμένοι λ. καθαρόν, Ap 15:6 (λίνον, Rec., R, mg., see Swete, in l); metaphorically, λ. τίμιοι, 1Co 3:12; of the tables of the law, 2Co 3:7; of idols, At 17:29
(AS)

G3038.def:
λιθό-στρωτος, -ον
(στρώννυμι), [in LXX: 2Cr 7:3, Et 1:6, Ct 3:10 (רִצְפָּה, רָצַף)* ;]
paved with stones, esp. of tessallated work (Ca, i.e.); as subst., τὸ λ., a tessallated pavement: Jo 19:13 (cf. Γαββαθᾶ).†
(AS)

G3039.def:
λικμάω, -ῶ
(λικμός = λίκνον, a winnowing-fan), [in LXX chiefly for זָרָה ni., pi., Rt 3:2 3Ki.14:15, Is 17:13, Jr 31:10, Dn 2:44, al. ;]
__1. in cl., to winnow (so Ru, l.with).
__2. In LXX (ll with, exc. Ru), to scatter (as chaff or dust): Lc 20:18 (RV, scatter as dust, Deiss., BS, 225 f., quotes ex. in π. which suggests the meaning ruin, destroy; cf. Vg. comminuet, AV, grind to powder; cf. also Kennedy, Sources, 126), Mt 21:44 [WH], R, txt.†
(AS)

G3040.def:
λιμήν, -ένος, ὁ
[in LXX: Sl 107:30 (מָחוֹז), Sl 107:35, 1Es.5:55 Et 5:1-2 Et 5:1-73 4Macc 7:1-23 * ;]
a harbour, haven: At 27:8, 12 (cf. Καλοὶ Λιμένες).†
(AS)

G3041.def:
λίμνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Sl 107:35 114:8 (אֲגַם), Ct 7:5 (בְּרֵכָה) 1Ma.11:35, 2Ma.12:16 * ;]
a lake: of the Sea of Galilee (Mt, Mk, see: θάλασσα), Lc 5:2 8:22-23, 33; λ. Γεννησαρέτ (which see), Lc 5:1; λ. τ. πυρός, Ap 19:20 20:10, 14-15; καιομένη πυρί, Ap 21:8.†
(AS)

G3042.def:
λιμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(so in Att..; in Dor. ἡ, and so sometimes in LXX, see Th., Gr., 146; in NT: Lc 15:14, At 11:28; cf. M, Pr., 60), [in LXX chiefly for רָעָב ;]
hunger, famine: Lc 4:25 15:14, 17, At 7:11" (LXX) At 11:28, Rm 8:35, Ap 6:8 18:8; λ. καὶ δίψος, 2Co 11:27; pl., Mt 24:7, Mc 13:8, Lc 21:11.†
(AS)

G3043.def:
λίνον
(Tr. λῖνον), -ου, τό [in LXX: Êx 9:31 (פִּשְׁתָּה), al. ;]
__1. flax: Mt 12:20 (LXX).
__2. linen: Ap 15:6 (R, mg., see: λίθος).†
λίθος, -ου, ὁ
(and, in Att.., of precious stones, ἡ.) [in LXX for אֶבֶן, Gn 11:3, al.; λ. τίμιος, for פָּז, Sl 19:10 21:3, Pv 8:19, al. ;]
a stone: Mt 4:6, al.; pl., Mt 3:9, al.; at the entrance of a tomb, Mt 27:60, 66 28:2, Mc 15:46 16:3-4, Lc 24:2, Jo 11:38, 32 11:41 20:1; λ. μυλικός, Lc 17:2, cf. Ap 18:21; of building stones, Mt 21:42, [44], Mt 24:2, Mc 12:10 13:1-2, Lc 19:44 20:17-18 21:5-6 At 4:11, 1Pe 2:7; metaphorically, of Christ, λ. ἀκρογωναῖος, ἐκλεκτός, ἔντιμος, 1Pe 2:6 (LXX); λ. ζῶν, 1Pe 2:4; προσκόμματος, 1Pe 2:8, Rm 9:33; of Christians, λ. ζῶντες, 1Pe 2:5; of precious stones, λ. τίμιος, Ap 17:4 18:12, 16 21:11, 19; ἴασπις, Ap 4:3; ἐνδεδυμένοι λ. καθαρόν, Ap 15:6 (λίνον, Rec., R, mg., see Swete, in l); metaphorically, λ. τίμιοι, 1Co 3:12; of the tables of the law, 2Co 3:7; of idols, At 17:29
(AS)

G3044.def:
1. Linos , a mythical minstrel, son of Apollo and Urania (Calliope), teacher of Orpheus, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus), etc.
2. as appellative, the song or lay of Linos , sung by a boy to the cithara while the vintagers are at work, Λίνον ὑπὸ καλὸν ἄειδεν sang the lovely lay of Linos in accompaniment, (Iliad by Homer):—;compare αἴλινος which is a mournful song. (ML)

G3045.def:
λιπαρός, -ά, -όν
(λίπος, fat), [in LXX: Jz 3:29, Ne 9:35, Is 30:23 (שָׁמֵן)* ;]
oily, fatty; metaphorically, of living, rich, dainty: τὰ λ. καὶ τ. λαμπρά, Ap 18:14.†
(AS)

G3046.def:
λίτρα, -ας, ἡ
(cf. Lat. libra),
__1. a Sicilian coin = Rom. libra or as.
__2. In weight, a pound: Jo 12:3 19:39.†
(AS)

G3047.def:
λίψ, λιβός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶב, also for תֵּימָן, מַעֲרָב, etc., Gn 13:14, Nm 2:10, 2Cr 32:30, al. ;]
the SW. wind: βλέποντα κατὰ λ., At 27:12 (see Page, in l; Deiss., ES, 141).†
(AS)

G3048.def:
λογία
(prop., -εία, see BS, 142 ff.), -ας, ἡ (λογεύω, to collect, a word found in π., see Deiss., BS, l.with; LAE, 70, 103; MM, xvi),
a collection: 1Co 16:1-2.†
(AS)

G3049.def:
λογίζομαι
(λόγος), [in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב ;]
__1. prop., of numerical calculation, to count, reckon: with accusative before μετά, Mc 15:23 (LXX) (Rec., R, mg.), Lc 22:37.
__2. Metaphorical, without reference to numbers, by a reckoning of characteristics or reasons;
__(a) to reckon, take into account: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 13:5; id. before dative of person(s), Rm 4:3 (LXX), Rm 4:4, 6 4:8" (LXX), 2Co 5:19, 2Tm 4:16; before εἰς (cf. Heb. ל חָשַׁב; Bl., § 33, 3), At 19:27, Rm 2:26 4:3, 5 4:9-11, 22-24 9:8 Gl 3:6" (LXX), Tg 2:23 (LXX);
__(b) to consider, calculate: with accusative of thing(s), Fp 4:8; before ὅτι, Jo 11:50, Hb 11:10; τοῦτο, ὅτι, 2Co 10:11; with accusative of person(s), with inf., Rm 6:11; before ὡς, Rm 8:36 (LXX);
__(with) to suppose, judge, deem: 1Co 13:11; ὡς, 1Pe 5:12; οὕτως, 1Co 4:1; with accusative of thing(s), 2Co 3:5; id. before εἰς, 2Co 12:6; ὅτι, Rm 8:18; τοῦτο, ὅτι, Rm 2:3, 2Co 10:7; with inf., 2Co 11:5; accusative and inf., Rm 3:28 14:14, Fp 3:13; with accusative of person(s) before ὡς, 2Co 10:2;
__(d) to purpose, decide: with inf. (Eur., Or., 555), 2Co 10:2
(cf. ἀνα-, δια-, παρα-, συλ-λογίζομαι).†
(AS)

G3050.def:
λογικός, -ή, -όν
(λόγος, reason)
reasonable, rational: λατρεία, Rm 12:1; τὸ λ. (i.e. spiritual) γάλα (see Hort, in l; MM, xvi), 1Pe 2:2 (in support of AV, milk of the word, see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G3051.def:
λόγιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of λόγος, see ICC, Ro., 70), [in LXX chiefly for אִמְרָה, אֵמֶר, Sl 18:30 19:14, al.; also for דָּבָר, Is 28:13, al.; (cf. λογεῖον (-ιον) for חֹשֶׁן the oracular breastplate of the H.P., Êx 28:15, al.) ;]
an oracle: At 7:38, Rm 3:2, Hb 5:12, 1Pe 4:11 (on the eccl., λόγια τ. Κυρίου, see Lft., Essay on Sup. Rel., 172 ff.).†
(AS)

G3052.def:
λόγιος, -ον
(λόγος),
__1. in cl., learned (Ac, l.with, R, txt.).
__2. In late Gk., eloquent: At 18:24 (see Page, in l; Field, Notes, 129).†
(AS)

G3053.def:
λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(λογίζομαι), [in LXX: Sl 33:10-11, Pv 19:21, Is 66:18, al. (מַחֲשָׁבָה) ;]
a reasoning, thought: Rm 2:15, 2Co 10:5.†
(AS)

G3056.def:
λόγος, -ου, ὁ (λέγω)
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, also for מִלָּה ,אֵמֶר, etc. ;]
__I. Of that by which the inward thought is expressed, Lat. oratio, sermo, vox, verbum.
__1. a word, not in the grammatical sense of a mere name (ἔπος, ὄνομα, ῥῆμα), but a word as embodying a conception or idea: Mt 8:8, Lc 7:7, 1Co 14:9, 19 Hb 12:19, al.
__2. a saying, statement, declaration: Mt 19:22 (T om.), Mc 5:36 7:29, Lc 1:29, Jo 2:22 6:60, At 7:29, al.; with genitive attrib., At 13:15, Rm 9:9, Hb 7:28, al.; of the sayings, commands, promises, etc., of teachers, Mt 7:24 10:14, Mc 8:38, Lc 9:4, Jo 14:24, al.; λ. κενοί, Ef 5:6; ἀληθινοί, Ap 19:9; πιστοί, Ap 22:6; esp. of the precepts, decrees and promises of God, ὁ λ. τ. θεοῦ, the word of God: Mc 7:13, Jo 10:35, Rm 13:9, 1Co 14:36, Fp 1:14, al.; absol., ὁ λ., Mt 13:21, 22 Mrk.16:[20], Lc 1:2, At 6:4, Hb 4:12, al.
__3. speech, discourse: At 14:12, 2Co 10:10, Tg 3:2; opposite to ἐπιστολή, 2Ts 2:15; disting, from σοφία, 1Co 2:1; ἀναστροφή, 1Tm 4:12; δύναμις, 1Co 4:19, 1Ts 1:5; ἔργον, Rm 15:18; οὐδενὸς λ. τίμιον (not worthy of mention), At 20:24; of the faculty of speech, Lc 24:19, 2Co 11:6; of the style of speech, Mt 5:37, 1Co 1:5; of instruction, Cl 4:3, 1Pe 3:1; with genitive of person(s), Jo 5:24 8:52, At 2:41, al.; ὁ λ. ὁ ἐμός, Jo 8:31; with genitive obj. (τ.) ἀληθείας, 2Co 6:7, Cl 1:5, Tg 1:18; τ. καταλλαγῆς, 2Co 5:19; τ. σταυροῦ, 1Co 1:18; of mere talk, 1Co 4:19, 2o, Cl 2:23, 1Jo 3:18; of the talk which one occasions, hence, repute: Cl 2:23.
__4. subject-matter, hence, teaching, doctrine: At 18:15, 2Tm 2:17, al.; esp. of Christian doctrine: Mt 13:20-23, Mc 4:14-20 8:32, Lc 1:2, At 8:4, Gl 6:6, 1Ts 1:6, al.; with genitive of person(s), τ. θεοῦ, Lc 5:1, Jo 17:6, At 4:29, 1Co 14:36, I Jo 1:10, Ap 6:9, al.; τ. Κυρίου, At 8:25, 1Ts 1:8, al.; τ. Χριστοῦ, Cl 3:16, Ap 3:8; with genitive appos., At 15:7; with genitive attrib., Hb 5:13.
__5. a story, tale, narrative: Mt 28:15, Jo 21:23, At 1:1 11:22; before περί, Lc 5:15.
__6. That which is spoken of (Plat., al.; V. Kennedy, Sources, 124), matter, affair, thing: Mt 21:24, Mc 1:45 11:29, Lc 20:3, At 8:21; of a matter in dispute, as a case or suit at law, At 19:38; pl. (1Ma.7:33, al.), Lc 1:4.
__II. Of the inward thought itself, Lat. ratio.
__1. reason,
__(a) of the mental faculty (Hdt., Plat., al.): κατὰ λόγον, At 18:14;
__(b) a reason, cause: τίνι λόγῳ, At 10:29; παρεκτὸς λόγου πορνείας, Mt 5:32 19:9, WH, mg., R, mg.
__2. account,
__(a) regard: At 20:24, Rec.;
__(b) reckoning: Fp 4:15, 17; συναίρειν (which see) λ., Mt 18:23 25:19; in forensic sense, Rm 14:12, Hb 13:17, 1Pe 4:5; with genitive of thing(s), Lc 16:2; before περί, Mt 12:36, At 19:40, 1Pe 3:15.
__3. proportion, analogy: Fp 2:16 (Field, Notes, 193 f.).
__III. ὁ λ., the Divine Word or Logos: Jo 1:1, 14; τ. ζωῆς, 1Jo 1:1; τ. θεοῦ, Ap 19:13 (see Westc, Swete, CGT, in ll.; reff. in Artt., Logos, DB, DCG).
(AS)

G3057.def:
λόγχη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for רֹמַח, etc. ;]
__1. a spear-head.
__2. a lance, spear: Mt 27:49 ([WH], R, mg.), Jo 19:34.†
(AS)

G3058.def:
λοιδορέω, -ῶ
(λοίδορος) [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
to abuse, revile: with accusative of person(s), Jo 9:28, At 23:4; pass., 1Co 4:12, 1Pe 2:23 (cf. ἀντι-λοιδορέω).†
(AS)

G3059.def:
λοιδορία, -ας, ἡ
(λοιδορέω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב, מְרִיבָה ;]
abuse, railing: 1Tm 5:14, 1Pe 3:9.†
(AS)

G3060.def:
λοίδορος, -ον
[in LXX: Pv 25:24 26:21 27:15 (מִדְיָן) Sir.23:8 * ;]
railing, abusive; as subst., ὁ λ., a railer: 1Co 5:11 6:10.†
(AS)

G3061.def:
λοιμός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for לוּץ, עָרִיץ, בְּלִיַּעַל, etc. ;]
pestilence: pl., Lc 21:11; metaphorically (as in cl.; LXX: Sl 1:1, Pv 21:24, 1Ma.15:21, al.), of persons, a pest: At 24:5 (also as adj., ἄνδρες λοιμοί, 1Ma.10:61, al.).†
(AS)

G3062.def:
λοιπός, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
the remaining, the rest,
__1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., Mt 25:11, At 2:37, Rm 1:13, al.; absol., Mt 22:6, Mc 16:13, Lc 24:10, al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), At 28:9, 1Ts 4:13, Ap 2:24; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), Ap 9:20; τὰ λ., Mc 4:19, Ap 3:2, al.
__2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
__(a) for the future, henceforth: Mc 14:41, 1Co 7:29 (Lft., Notes, 232 f.), Hb 10:13; anarth. (Deiss., LAE, 17616, 1885, 20), At 27:20, 2Tm 4:8; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, Pr., 73; Bl., § 36, 13), Gl 6:17, Ef 6:10;
__(b) besides, moreover, for the rest: Fp 3:1 4:8; anarth., 1Co 1:16 4:2, 1Ts 4:1 (M, Th., in l; Lft., Notes, 51)
(AS)

G3063.def:
λοιπός, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
the remaining, the rest,
__1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., Mt 25:11, At 2:37, Rm 1:13, al.; absol., Mt 22:6, Mc 16:13, Lc 24:10, al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), At 28:9, 1Ts 4:13, Ap 2:24; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), Ap 9:20; τὰ λ., Mc 4:19, Ap 3:2, al.
__2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
__(a) for the future, henceforth: Mc 14:41, 1Co 7:29 (Lft., Notes, 232 f.), Hb 10:13; anarth. (Deiss., LAE, 17616, 1885, 20), At 27:20, 2Tm 4:8; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, Pr., 73; Bl., § 36, 13), Gl 6:17, Ef 6:10;
__(b) besides, moreover, for the rest: Fp 3:1 4:8; anarth., 1Co 1:16 4:2, 1Ts 4:1 (M, Th., in l; Lft., Notes, 51)
(AS)

G3064.def:
λοιπός, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
the remaining, the rest,
__1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., Mt 25:11, At 2:37, Rm 1:13, al.; absol., Mt 22:6, Mc 16:13, Lc 24:10, al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), At 28:9, 1Ts 4:13, Ap 2:24; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), Ap 9:20; τὰ λ., Mc 4:19, Ap 3:2, al.
__2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
__(a) for the future, henceforth: Mc 14:41, 1Co 7:29 (Lft., Notes, 232 f.), Hb 10:13; anarth. (Deiss., LAE, 17616, 1885, 20), At 27:20, 2Tm 4:8; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, Pr., 73; Bl., § 36, 13), Gl 6:17, Ef 6:10;
__(b) besides, moreover, for the rest: Fp 3:1 4:8; anarth., 1Co 1:16 4:2, 1Ts 4:1 (M, Th., in l; Lft., Notes, 51)
(AS)

G3065.def:
Λουκᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ
(prob. an abbreviation of Λουκανός; see Lft., Col., 240; ICC, Lk., xviii; Bl., § 29; accusative to Ramsay, Exp., Dec., 1912, pp. 502 ff., a by-form of Λούκιος, from Lat. Lucius),
Luke: Lk, tit., Cl 4:14, 2Tm 4:11, Phm 24.†
(AS)

G3067.def:
λουτρόν, -οῦ, τό
(λούω), [in LXX: Ct 4:2 6:5, (6) (רַחְצָה), Sir.34:25 * ;]
a washing, bath: τ. ὕδατος, Ef 5:26; τ. παλιγγενεσίας, Tt 3:5 (see AR, Eph., l.with).†
(AS)

G3068.def:
λούω
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַץ (frequently of ceremonial washing; cf. Deiss., BS, 226 f.) ;]
to bathe, wash the body: with accusative of person(s), At 9:37 (of a dead body); id. before ἀπό (Deiss., BS, l.with), At 16:33; pass. ptcp. pf., Jo 13:10, Hb 10:22; mid., to wash oneself (Mayor, in l; M. Pr., 155 f., 238 f.), 2Pe 2:22; metaphorically, Ap 1:5, Rec., R, mg. (cf. ἀπο-λούω).†
SYN.: νίπτω, used of parts of the body-hands, feet, face; πλύνω, of things, as garments, etc. (see Lv 15:11; cf. Tr., Syn., § xlv) (AS)

G3069.def:
λύδδα, -ας (At 9:38, -ης Rec.), ἡ and λύδδα, -ων, τά (At 9:32, 35; -αν, Rec.), (Heb. לֹד),
Lydda (modern Ludd): Ac, ll. with†
(AS)

G3070.def:
Λυδία, -ας, ἡ
Lydia, a woman of Thyatira: At 16:14, 40.†
(AS)

G3071.def:
Λυκαονία, -ας, ἡ
Lycaonia, a region in Asia Minor: At 14:6.†
(AS)

G3073.def:
Λυκία, -ας, ἡ
Lydia, a region of Asia Minor; At 27:5.†
(AS)

G3074.def:
λύκος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for זְאֵב ;]
a wolf: Mt 10:16, Lc 10:3, Jo 10:12; figuratively (as Eze.22:27, Sf 3:3, Jr 5:6, al.), Mt 7:1, At 20:29.†
(AS)

G3075.def:
λυμαίνομαι
(λύμη, outrage), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת pi., hi., also for כִּרְסֵם, etc. ;]
__1. to outrage, maltreat: with accusative, At 8:3.
__2. to corrupt, defile (Eze.16:25, Pv 23:8, 4Ma.18:8, al.).†
(AS)

G3076.def:
λυπέω, -ῶ
(λύπη), [in LXX for חָרָה, etc. ;]
to distress, grieve, cause pain or grief: with accusative of person(s), 2Co 2:2 2:5 7:8; pass., Mt 14:9 17:23 18:31 19:22 26:22, Mc 10:22 14:19, Jo 16:20 21:17, Rm 14:15, 2Co 2:4, 1Ts 4:13, 1Pe 1:6; λ. καὶ ἀδημονεῖν, Mt 26:37; opposite to χαίρειν, 2Co 6:10; κατὰ θεόν, 2Co 7:9 7:11; τ. πνεῦμα τ. ἅγιον, Ef 4:30 (cf. συν-λνπέω),†
SYN.: see: θρηνέω (AS)

G3077.def:
λύπη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for עֶצֶב and cogn. forms, etc. ;]
pain of body or mind, grief, sorrow: Jo 16:6, 2Co 2:7; opposite to χαρά, Jo 16:20, Hb 12:11; ἀπὸ τῆς λ., Lc 22:45; ἐκ λ., 2Co 9:7; ἡ κατὰ θεὸν λ., opposite to ἡ τ. κόσ-μου λ., 2Co 7:10; λ. μοι ἐστιν, Rm 9:2; λ. ἔχω, Jo 16:21-22; id. before ἀπό, 2Co 2:3; λ. ἐπὶ λ. ἔχω, Fp 2:27; ἐν λ. ἐλθεῖν, 2Co 2:1 (to come sad and cause sadness); pl. (cf. Gn 3:16, Pv 15:13, al.), 1Pe 2:19.†
(AS)

G3080.def:
λύσις, -εως, ἡ
(λύω), [in LXX: Ec 8:1 (Ec 8:1) (פֵּשֶׁר), Dan LXX 12:8, Wis.8:8 * ;]
a loosing: of divorce, 1Co 7:27.†
(AS)

G3081.def:
λυσιτελέω, -ῶ
(λυσιτελής, useful, prop., τὰ τέλη λύων), [in LXX: Tob.3:6, Sir.20:10, 14 29:11 * ;]
__1. prop., to indemnify, pay expenses.
__2. to be useful, to profit; usually impers., λυσιτελεῖ, it profits: with, dative of person(s), before εἰ . . . ἤ, Lc 17:2.†
(AS)

G3082.def:
λύστρα, -ας, ἡ
and (in At 14:8 16:2, 2Ti, l.with) -ων, τά (cf. Λύδδα),
Lystra, a city of Lycaonia: At 14:6, 8 14:21 16:1-2, 2Tm 3:11.†
(AS)

G3083.def:
λύτρον, -ον, τό
(λύω), [in LXX (Pent. .15 Pr .2, Isa .1) for פִּדְיוֹם and cogn. forms, גְּאֻלָּה, כֹּפֶר, מְחִיר ;]
a ransom (as for a life, Êx 21:30; for slaves, Lv 19:20; for captives, Is 45:13): ἀντὶ πολλῶν, Mt 20:28, Mc 10:45 (see Swete, in l, and for discussion of λ. and its cognates, Westc., He., 295 f.; Deiss., LAE, 331 f.; cf. also ἀντί-λύτρον).†
(AS)

G3084.def:
λυτρόω, -ῶ
(λύτρον, which see), [in LXX chiefly for פָּדָה, גָּאַל ;]
to release on receipt of ransom; mid., to release by paying ransom, to redeem: in spiritual sense, Tt 2:14; pass, 1Pe 1:18; in general sense, to deliver (cf. Êx 6:6, Sl 69:18, al.): Lc 24:21.†
(AS)

G3085.def:
λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(λυτρόω), [in LXX: Lv 25:29, 48, Is 63:4 גְּאֻלָּה), Nm 18:16, Sl 49:8 111:9 130:7 (פָּדָה, פִּדְיוֹם, פְּדוּת), Jz 1:15 * ;]
a ransoming, redemption (αἰχμαλώτων, Plut., Arat., 11): of the mediatorial work of Christ, Hb 9:12; in general sense, deliverance(cf. Sl 4:8, l.with): Lc 1:68 2:38.†
(AS)

G3086.def:
λυτρωτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(λυτρόω), [in LXX: of God, Sl 19:14 78:35 (גָּאַל)* ;]
a redeemer, deliverer: At 7:35 (not found elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3087.def:
λυχνία, -ας, ἡ
(vulgar form of λυχνίον = λυχνοῦχος; see Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX for מְנוֹרָה (Êx 25:31 40:4, al.) ;]
a lampstand: Mt 5:15, Mc 4:21, Lc 8:16 11:33; of that in the Tabernacle, Hb 9:2; metaphorically, of the two witnesses, Ap 11:4; of the seven churches of Asia, Ap 1:12-13, 20 2:1; of the removal of a church from its position, κινεῖν τ. λυχνίαν κ.τ.λ., Ap 2:5.†
(AS)

G3088.def:
λύχνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for נִיר (Êx 25:37), al.) ;]
a lamp (portable, and usually set on a stand, λυχνία): Mt 5:15, Lc 11:36; ἔρχεται ὁ λ., Mc 4:21; λ. ἅπτειν Lc 8:16 11:33 15:8; φῶς λύχνου, Ap 18:23; id. opposite to φ.ἡλίου, Ap 22:5; metaphorically, of the eye, Mt 6:22 Lc 11:34; of John the Baptist, Jo 5:35; of the Lamb, Ap 21:23; of prophecy, 2Pe 1:19; of spiritual readiness, pl., λύχνοι (as always in LXX; frequently in Att.. λύχνα), Lc 12:35.†
SYN.: λαμπάς, q.v (AS)

G3089.def:
λύω
[in LXX for פָּתַח, נָתַר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to loose, unbind, release: of things, Mc 1:7, Lc 3:16, al.; of beasts, Mt 21:2, Lc 13:15, al.; of persons, Jo 11:44, At 22:30; of Satan, Ap 20:3, 7; metaphorically, of the marriage tie, 1Co 7:27; of one diseased, Lc 13:16; of release from sin, Ap 1:5, WH, R, txt. (see: λούω).
__2. To resolve a whole into its parts, loosen, dissolve, break up, destroy: Jo 2:19, At 27:41, Ap 5:2; metaphorically, 2Pe 3:11; of an assembly, to dismiss: At 13:43; τ. μεσότοιχον τ. φραγμοῦ, Ef 2:14; τ. στοιχεῖα, 2Pe 3:10; οὐρανοί, 2Pe 3:12; τ. ἔργα τ. διαβόλου, 1Jo 3:8; τ. ὠδῖνας τ. θανάτου, At 2:24; of laws, etc., to break, annul, cancel (MM, xvi): ἐντολήν, Mt 5:19; τ. νόμον, Jo 7:23; τ. σάββατον, Jo 5:18; τ. γραφήν, Jo 10:35.
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-λύω.)
(AS)

G3091.def:
Λώτ, ὁ (Heb. לוֹט), indecl.,
Lot (Gn 11:27, al.): Lc 17:28-29, 32, 2Pe 2:7.†
(AS)

G3093.def:
Μαγαδάν
Magadan, an unidentified place on the coast of the Sea of Galilee: Mt 15:39 (Rec. Μαγδαλά; cf. Mc 8:10, where for Δαλμανουθά, D* has Μελεγαδά, D1 Μαγαιδά, some cursives Μαγαδά, and Euseb. Onomast. Μεγαιδάν; cf. DB, iii, see word).†
Μαγδαλά (Aram. מַגְדְֺּלָא = Heb. H4026, which in Js 15:37 B is rendered Μαγαδά),
Magdala: Mt 15:39 (Rec. for Μαγαδάν, which see).†
(AS)

G3094.def:
Μαγδαληνός, -ά, όν
Magdalene, of Magdala: Μαρία (which see) ἡ MM., Mt 27:56, 61 28:1, Mc 15:40, 47 16:1, 9, Lc 8:2 24:10, Jo 19:25 20:1, 18†
(AS)

G3095.def:
μαγία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(μάγος),
__1. the lore of the Magians (Plat.).
__2. magic: pl., magic arts, sorceries: At 8:11.†
(AS)

G3096.def:
μαγεύω (Eur., Plut., al.),
__1. to be a Magus, or skilled in Magian lore.
__2. to practise magic: At 8:9.†
(AS)

G3097.def:
μάγος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for אַשָּׁף, Dan LXX TH Dn 2:2, 10, al. (cf. chief magian, Jr 39:3, 13) ;]
__1. one of the Μάγοι, a Median tribe (Hat).
__2. a Magian, one of a sacred caste, originally Median, who seem to have conformed to the Persian religion, while retaining some of their old beliefs (see DB, I vol., 565 f.; DB, iii, 203 ff.): Mt 2:1, 7 2:16
__3. a wizard, sorcerer: At 13:6, 8 (cf. Wis.17:7, At 8:9; ?At 8:1).†
(AS)

G3098.def:
Μαγώγ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מָגוֹג, Gn 10:2, Êx 38:2, al.),
Magog, associated with Gog: Ap 20:8 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G3099.def:
Μαδιάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִדְיָן),
Midian;
__1. son of Abraham (Gn 25:2).
__2. An Arabian tribe (Gn 36:35, Sl 83:9, al).
__3. γῆ Μ. (Heb. מִדְיָן אֶרֶץ), the land of Midian (Êx 2:15, al.): At 7:29.†
(AS)
